behaviour.title: The routed arms are not equivalent - the 'standard' arm takes no action of its own
behaviour.detail: Route by Work Type splits the run. The 'express' arm ends at Fast-Track 'express' + Alert, which sends an SMS through Twilio. The 'standard' arm goes to Delegate 'standard' to Sub-workflow, which calls the included sub-workflow lib: Process Standard Order - that sub-workflow normalises the item and tags it with the route, but performs no action of its own, so the branch completes and nothing is sent, filed or updated for it. Add the handling you want inside lib: Process Standard Order before relying on that arm.

Import that file into n8n first (Workflows -> Import from File), then open Offload to Post-Process Sub-workflow and pick it in the workflowId selector. The selector is empty until you do: a workflow id only exists inside your own instance, so it cannot be set for you.

bindings.title: Select the Airtable base
bindings.detail: The dropdown shows "SEO Automation Base", which is a placeholder label with no value behind it - the node looks configured and is not. Open each of: Load Previous Snapshot, Park in Dead-Letter Queue, Update Changed Rows, Write Fresh Snapshot and pick the real base from the list.

bindings.title: Select the Airtable table
bindings.detail: The dropdown shows "Pages", which is a placeholder label with no value behind it - the node looks configured and is not. Open each of: Load Previous Snapshot, Park in Dead-Letter Queue, Update Changed Rows, Write Fresh Snapshot and pick the real table from the list.

bindings.title: Select the Notion databaseId
bindings.detail: The dropdown shows "Page Database", which is a placeholder label with no value behind it - the node looks configured and is not. Open each of: Append Audit Row (Notion), Load Previous Snapshot 2 and pick the real databaseId from the list.

bindings.title: Select the Google Sheets documentId
bindings.detail: The dropdown shows "Page Tracker", which is a placeholder label with no value behind it - the node looks configured and is not. Open Archive Row Snapshot and pick the real documentId from the list.

behaviour.title: Point the HTTP calls at your own endpoint
behaviour.detail: The URL "enrichment.example.com" is illustrative - example.com is reserved for documentation and resolves to nothing useful. Replace it with the service you are actually calling, and set that service's authentication on the node.

behaviour.title: Clear the pinned sample data before going live
behaviour.detail: "Daily Schedule" carries pinned sample data, which is what lets the workflow run end to end before you have wired anything up. While it is pinned, a manual execution reads the sample and never calls the real service - so the run succeeds and proves nothing about your setup. Unpin it once the credentials and bindings are in place.
